reasoning: The icon consists solely of the letters 'PNG' inside a rectangular border, representing a file format attribute rather than a visual object. At small to-do list sizes, three-letter text badges are hard to read and indistinguishable from other format badges (JPG, GIF, SVG), and tasks about images are better served by a picture or image icon.
